scope: Consumer compatibility of the production bounded transport, redirects, JSON caps, cancellation and CE dependency ownership. This is not blanket security equivalence of old and bundled libraries.
fresh_install: Seed signed bundled originals only when the Kodi addon is absent; retain Kodi ownership after installation.
upgrade: Preserve installed Kodi addons at or above the tested floor; do not require versions absent from the official Kodi Omega repository.
device_receipt: Record actual requests and urllib3 __version__, __file__, Python version and installed dependency origins on the target CE before promotion.
